title: Discriminant Dungeon
description: Use b²-4ac and completing the square to escape the quadratic maze.

concepts.def: ax²+bx+c=0 with a≠0 is the standard quadratic.
Δ = b²-4ac tells you the nature of roots.
If b²-4ac > 0 the quadratic has two distinct real roots.
If b²-4ac = 0 there is one repeated real root.
If b²-4ac < 0 there are no real solutions (complex pair).
x²+bx+c = (x+b/2)² + c - (b/2)² gives min/max and roots.
